title: Partner chat (NWSChat style)
description: A partner chat transcript between the forecast office, emergency managers and broadcasters; each message has a time, a name with organization and text. Exercise product: the template adds an exercise banner. Real NWS office, center and station identifiers; the county, places and people are fictional.

examples: Tornado warning for central Haldane County until 3:45 PM. Rotating storm near Milford.
